rootCause: Catalog discovery admits all Git-visible report paths, but retained snapshots recognize only reports/.snapshots. The before-test name is therefore advertised as a canonical root-node suite even though the canonical runner excludes report paths and rejects that selector.
requiredFixes: Classify retained report source artifacts by evidence ownership before suffix-based canonical test detection; preserve their indexed path, provenance and reproduction instructions.
Keep actual canonical test sources and executable support recipes discoverable in their appropriate groups. Do not drop the historical file or rerun it as current acceptance.
riskLevel: Low execution risk; moderate audit-completeness ambiguity.
validationCriteria: Fixture containing an actual current tests/*.test.mjs and its old report copy catalogs only the current file as canonical and retains the report bytes/hash as historical.
Ordinary reports/<cohort>/test-before.mjs and reports/<cohort>/.snapshots/test-before.mjs both remain retained, never active wrapper selectors.
Current canonical Node/TypeScript/Python/commerce/operational/support source registrations remain unchanged; no filename-only suppression outside report-owned paths.
Report-only validators/replay recipes remain documented as such and are not silently removed from inventory.
Catalog root-node path set equals default Node discovery plus explicitly separately grouped/blocked canonical sources, and every generated --file command is admitted by the owning runner.
Correction changes no execution receipt, counters, coverage target, production source denominator, existing page or section identity.
productionAcceptanceCriteria: The index and canonical runner agree on 124 current Node files for this snapshot, while the historical before source remains a retained snapshot with its original failed proof.

diagnostic.scope: Read-only source classification and discovery; no script/test/application executed
